source.text: SEC. 50402. REPEALS; RESCISSIONS. (a) Repeal and Rescission.--Section 50142 of Public Law 117-169 (136 Stat. 2044) (commonly known as the ``Inflation Reduction Act of 2022'') is repealed and the unobligated balance of amounts made available under that section (as in effect on the day before the date of enactment of this Act) is rescinded. (b) Rescissions.-- (1) In general.--The unobligated balances of amounts made available under the sections described in paragraph (2) are rescinded. (2) Sections described.--The sections referred to in paragraph (1) are the following sections of Public Law 117-169 (commonly known as the ``Inflation Reduction Act of 2022''): (A) Section 50123 (42 U.S.C. 18795b). (B) Section 50141 (136 Stat. 2042). (C) Section 50144 (136 Stat. 2044). (D) Section 50145 (136 Stat. 2045). (E) Section 50151 (42 U.S.C. 18715). (F) Section 50152 (42 U.S.C. 18715a). (G) Section 50153 (42 U.S.C. 18715b). (H) Section 50161 (42 U.S.C. 17113b).
